title: Amazon employees hit by fresh job cuts across several teams
key_facts: Amazon employees reported a new round of job cuts across several parts of the company on Tuesday, 6 Oct 2026.
Employees described the emails in an internal Slack channel; the cuts span customer service, marketplace support and engineering roles in Amazon's retail business, including India and the UK.
Amazon confirmed it eliminated 'a small number' of roles, primarily in its Stores business.
A person familiar with the matter said fewer than 1,000 employees were affected in total.
Amazon is preparing to spend a record $220 billion on data centers, chips and other AI infrastructure, after cutting roughly 30,000 jobs late last year and early this year.
Amazon is also contacting former employees about open roles in AWS and its AI businesses.
quote_evidence: We've adjusted parts of our Stores business because we believe this structure will better enable us to deliver on our priorities.
